topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I stumbled upon my college application essay online, featured as an example for aspiring students. The pride should have been palpable, a triumph after countless nights of drafting and refining. Yet, as I scrolled through the glowing words, each sentence felt like a trespass. My thoughts, once private, now open for scrutiny. I considered the time and effort, the pouring of my heart into those pages. It seemed now that every word had been too honest, too vulnerable. The line between sharing and exposing blurred, leaving me to grapple with the unforeseen weight of digital permanence.
